unit: public debt with no public register
what: Kenya's total public debt without a single publicly accessible register listing lenders, terms, and projects.
why: We pay foreign loans via PAYE and fuel levies without knowing the terms.
check: Read the National Assembly Public Debt Committee Report on parliament.go.ke.
message: Kenya owes over Sh10.5 trillion in public debt, yet Parliament is only now pushing for an open register.
action: Track your taxes: read the Public Debt Committee report on parliament.go.ke
source: National Assembly Public Debt and Privatisation Committee Report, October 2026; Central Bank of Kenya Public Debt Statistical Bulletin
caption:
Kenya owes Sh10.5 trillion, but ordinary taxpayers cannot look up who was paid what. Now Parliament admits we need an open debt register. We pay the bills; show us the books.

#PublicDebt #FollowTheMoney #KenyansAreAsking

line: Tokens run out instantly if you owe Kenya Power 50 bob, but state ministries owe them *Sh7.35 billion*.
fact: Government ministries and state departments owe Kenya Power Sh7.35 billion in unpaid electricity bills.
source: Daily Nation, Oct 13, 2026: Govt debt to Kenya Power rises to Sh7.35 billion
message: Wananchi get disconnected over small debts while government departments pile up Sh7.35 billion in unpaid power bills.
action: Ask your MP to demand state ministries clear their Sh7.35bn power debt
caption:
Your power gets cut off for 50 shillings. Meanwhile, government offices owe Kenya Power Sh7.35 billion and the lights stay on. Who ends up footing the bill through higher tariffs? Kenyans are asking.

Tag your MP: when are state ministries settling their power bills?

promise: Guaranteed paid internships for all university and college graduates within six months of completion.
reality: PSC recruits fewer than 10,000 interns a year while over 100,000 students graduate annually.
ask: Kenyans are asking: where are the graduate internships?
source: Kenya Kwanza Manifesto 2022, Youth Charter; Public Service Commission Annual Reports 2023-2025
proof: PSC reports show under 10,000 paid slots available per fiscal year.
Over 100,000 comrades leave universities and TVETs annually with no placement.
Graduates still rely on unpaid attachments to seek entry-level roles.
message: Over 100,000 comrades graduate annually into unpaid work despite a promise of guaranteed paid internships.
action: Demand your MP push for expanded public internship funding in the next budget
caption:
Every graduation season, thousands of comrades leave campus with degrees but zero paid openings. The promise was guaranteed paid internships for every graduate within six months. The record shows under 10,000 public slots a year.

Did you or anyone you know secure a state internship after campus?

line: Gachagua claims *fuel price hikes* fund 2027 campaigns, but at the pump we just pay. Where does our money go?
fact: Fuel carries nine taxes and levies, making up about 40% of the pump price per litre in Kenya.
source: Capital FM (14 Oct 2026): https://capitalfm.africa/gachagua-accuses-ruto-of-using-fuel-price-hikes-to-fund-2027-campaigns/ | EPRA pricing breakdown
message: Politicians trade 2027 campaign claims over fuel, but ordinary Kenyans still pay nine levies on every litre.
action: Check EPRA's tax breakdown on your fuel receipt and ask your MP why levies stay high
who: Rigathi Gachagua and Energy CS Opiyo Wandayi
impact: Taxes take about 40% of every litre, driving up matatu fares, electricity, and basic food costs.
beats: Demand your MP audit fuel taxes.
caption:
Politicians are trading 2027 campaign claims over fuel, but wananchi are the ones footing the bill at the pump.

What it means for you: Taxes take about 40% of every litre, driving up matatu fares, electricity, and basic food costs.

Kenyans are asking the National Treasury: why do ordinary Kenyans carry nine fuel levies while leaders fight over 2027? Check EPRA's tax breakdown on your fuel receipt and ask your MP to audit fuel levies.

claim: Elections can be manipulated by using fingerprints of dead voters.
claim_source: Remarks cited in IEBC summons notice, 15 Oct 2026
truth: KIEMS kits require live biometrics and reject deceased records.
proof: Elections Act Sec 8 requires IEBC to expunge deceased voters via civil registry data.
KIEMS kits require a live optical biometric match against registered voter records.
System logs create an immutable audit trail rejecting unverified biometric attempts.
pride: Kenyan voter technology runs on verifiable law.
source: Elections Act 2011 s.8; Supreme Court of Kenya Petition No. E005 of 2022; IEBC Voter Registration Regulations
message: KIEMS kits require live biometrics: dead voters cannot cast ballots under Kenyan election law.
action: Check your voter registration status: SMS your ID number to 70000
beats: Civil registry data purges dead files.
caption:
Politicians are talking about dead voters casting ballots ahead of 2027. The law and the technology say otherwise: KIEMS kits require live biometric verification, and Section 8 of the Elections Act mandates continuous register cleanups.

What it means for you: Unbacked claims create voter apathy before the election even starts.

Check your voter registration status: SMS your ID number to 70000.

#SetItStraight #KenyansAreAsking
impact: Sensational voter claims create voter apathy and undermine trust in lawful election tech.

action: Report fake invoice schemes to the KRA whistleblower portal
beats: We pay tax. Others forge receipts.

impact: Ordinary Kenyans carry the tax burden while fraudulent invoices siphon billions.

who: Kamau Thugge, Central Bank of Kenya Governor
promise: Launch a dealer-led Over-The-Counter platform to modernize secondary trading of Treasury securities.
reality: CBK and market players rolled out the dealer-led OTC platform for trading Treasury bills and bonds.
ask: Kenyans are asking: will this lower public borrowing costs?
source: Briefs Finance, Oct 2026; Central Bank of Kenya Secondary Market Framework
proof: The dealer-led OTC platform enables commercial banks to trade securities in real time.
Replaces slow manual trading to increase liquidity in domestic debt markets.
Aimed at providing transparent pricing for Treasury bills and government bonds.
message: The Central Bank delivered its pledge to modernize bond trading through a dealer-led market platform.
action: Track government bond rates on the Central Bank website
caption:
Credit where due: the Central Bank promised an Over-The-Counter platform to modernize how Treasury bills and bonds are traded, and it has gone live. Open market pricing brings transparency to domestic borrowing.

Will this translate to lower interest rates on our public debt? Tell us what you think.

Over Sh6.2 billion vanished through government ghost payrolls. The response: 84 HR officers get 30 days leave.
What it means for you: Your taxes fund ghost salaries while essential public services stall.
Kenyans are asking the Ministry of Public Service: where is our Sh6.2 billion? Demand full payroll audit reports today.
